title: Hermès
summary: Hermes is the most insulated of all the luxury brands, where they have the least cost sensitive clients. It enables you as the seller to completely switch tracks to disconnect from any evaluation of value. They come from the world of couture, of fashion, and of cutting edge, in your face, risky art.

thesis: The episode introduces Hermès as a company founded in 1837 that has grown to be worth over 200 billion while rejecting manufacturing efficiencies and economies of scale. The hosts describe the company as being so obsessed with craft and reputation for quality that it has stayed independent while other luxury brands merged into conglomerates.
